item.title: Mini leads F2 practice
item.description: Gabriele Minì started off the opening weekend of the FIA Formula 2 season in Melbourne on a strong footing ending the practice session at Albert Park quickest of all, while America's Colton Herta had a rough start to his rookie campaign, triggering a red flag with a spin.

item.title: Leclerc leads Ferrari 1-2 in opening Australian GP practice
item.description: Charles Leclerc led teammate Lewis Hamilton for a Ferrari one-two in the opening practice session of the 2026 season at the Australian Grand Prix.

item.title: Bowman to sit out Phoenix after vertigo diagnosis
item.description: Alex Bowman will sit out this weekend’s NASCAR Cup Series race at Phoenix Raceway after being diagnosed with vertigo. Anthony Alfredo, the simulator driver for Hendrick Motorsports and Chevrolet, will drive the No. 48 Hendrick Chevrolet in his place.

item.title: Herta crash hits F2 debut preparations in Melbourne
item.description: Colton Herta crashed eight laps into the only practice session at the Australian Grand Prix, hampering his preparations for his Formula 2 debut.

item.title: Piastri tops second Australian Grand Prix practice as Mercedes teams surge forward
item.description: Oscar Piastri has ended Friday practice at his home Australian Grand Prix with the fastest time as the Mercedes-engined cars surged back into contention.
